name: 箭雨药水
focus: Straight coaxial neck, mouth and cork; mouth and cork-top planes perpendicular to the neck centerline.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate a completely NEW hand-painted 2D fantasy potion inventory illustration from a blank canvas. No previous image is being edited or traced.

Subject:
A tangible arrowhead-shaped glass flask filled with violet potion, named Arrow Rain Potion. A substantial broad kite-like body, an angular pointed bottom with thick solid glass, a narrow visible sidewall and a broad front face. Compact painted game-item style in the visual language of Slay the Spire 2 potions. One actual glass vessel with volume and an inner cavity, never a flat arrow glyph.

CRITICAL CONSTRUCTION — straight, coaxial neck and stopper:
The WHOLE bottle leans 25 degrees clockwise from upright, cork toward the upper right and pointed body toward the lower left.
Imagine ONE straight centerline through the bottle neck. The center of the mouth, the center of the glass lip, and the center of the cork are ALL on this exact same line.
The short cylindrical neck is straight. The cork's side edges run PARALLEL to the sides of the neck. The cork is inserted straight into the neck, with no extra sideways tilt.
The circular mouth is cut square to the neck. Its opening is one clean symmetrical ellipse in perspective, with its long axis PERPENDICULAR to the neck centerline. The cork top and glass-mouth ellipse have matching orientation and parallel planes. The lip is an even thick glass ring, with consistent near and far sides.
Use a MODEST SHORT cork so the alignment reads clearly. Do not draw a bent spout, twisted neck, offset mouth, slanted opening cut, or a cork leaning at a different angle from the neck.
Keep the mouth construction simple and physically plausible.

Materials and volume:
Three-quarter view with a narrow receding sidewall and thick glass at the pointed bottom. Inner cavity stops before the outer tip. A clearly hollow neck above the liquid. Muted blue-gray glass edges, medium violet liquid, deep plum shadow and lavender reflections, warm brown cork with a couple of pores.
Liquid fills about two thirds of the cavity; its surface stays nearly horizontal in world space despite the tilted bottle, with a modest elliptical meniscus and two small bubbles. Empty cavity above it.
Paint the actual material planes and overlaps: rim around neck, cork seated inside rim, glass wall in front of liquid. Broad, economical, slightly irregular painted color shapes; a few firm brush highlights and compact shading facets. A dark hand-drawn outer contour. Avoid uniform neon edging, perfect vector paths, smooth UI gradients or photorealism.

Composition:
One complete isolated bottle on a genuinely TRANSPARENT SQUARE canvas, centered, filling most of the frame with padding.
No UI panel, logo, text, label, scene, cast shadow, aura, additional props or physical arrows inside the bottle.
